name: Dar Al Arkan Real Estate Development Company
summary: Dar Al Arkan Real Estate Development Company, together with its subsidiaries, primarily engages in the development, management, lease, and sale of real estate projects and associated activities in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It is involved in the management, operation, and maintenance of residential and commercial buildings, as well as public facilities; purchase of land and general contracting; real estate investments; and leasing and property management. The company was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Riyadh, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
